fields.proposition: Heritage: pure nutrition, because it comes from a pure source.
fields.objective: Heritage: pure nutrition, because it comes from a pure source.
fields.audience: draft a brief for heritage masterbrand with the proposition of pure nutrition comes from pure milk sources from the farmers fresh and quality checked every day targeting women in the age group of 25-44 and key competition being dodla, hatsun, arokya, nandini, amul, jersey

competitors.name: Amul
competitors.hero_brands: Amul Taaza, Amul Gold, Amul butter
competitors.positioning: The national cooperative — 'The Taste of India', mass ubiquity, farmer-owned equity and unbeatable trust at scale
competitors.recent_moves: Aggressive value-milk and value-added dairy expansion, heavy topical social advertising, deep quick-commerce distribution

competitors.name: Nandini
competitors.hero_brands: Nandini Goodlife, Nandini curd, Nandini ghee
competitors.positioning: Karnataka cooperative (KMF) — pride-of-state provenance, freshness and affordability with strong regional loyalty

competitors.positioning: Arokya sub-brand leads on 'healthy milk' and freshness in Tamil Nadu; Hatsun as the private-dairy freshness leader
competitors.recent_moves: Widening south-India cold-chain, health-forward messaging, value-added premiumisation via Ibaco and Arun

competitors.name: Dodla
competitors.hero_brands: Dodla milk, Dodla curd, Dodla ghee
competitors.positioning: Andhra/Telangana private dairy — freshness and consistent quality at accessible prices, farmer-sourcing narrative
competitors.recent_moves: Geographic expansion, retail and modern-trade push, procurement-network storytelling

competitors.name: Jersey
competitors.hero_brands: Jersey milk, Jersey curd, Jersey paneer
competitors.positioning: South-India private dairy leaning on 'pure and fresh' with a premium-quality signal
competitors.recent_moves: Portfolio premiumisation and curd/paneer value-added growth

needscope.reading: The category clusters tightly in Belonging — Amul (national cooperative warmth), Nandini (state pride) and Dodla (regional freshness) all trade on inclusive family trust, leaving that territory over-claimed. Heritage sits in Belonging with a natural pull toward Security, where its verifiable farmer-fresh, quality-checked-daily sourcing gives it permission the cooperatives cannot match on a person-to-person basis. The whitespace is Security-as-proof: not vague 'purity' but a daily, source-traceable guarantee of nutrition — a territory Jersey and Arokya gesture at on quality but no one has systematised into a brand promise.

cb: Bought largely on availability and price parity — milk is a substitutable daily commodity, not a chosen brand.
Consumed almost entirely as an ingredient — chai, coffee, cooking — rarely a considered nutrition decision.
Under-represented in value-added and health-forward baskets (fortified, high-protein, curd, functional dairy).
db: Actively chosen by the household nutrition gatekeeper because the source is trusted and verifiable, not just because it is on the shelf.
Traded up within the franchise: standard milk to fortified, high-protein and value-added variants for the family.
Consumed with intent across new occasions — children's growth, women's own nutrition, morning wellness routines.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: Milk is milk — I buy whatever is fresh and available that morning; Heritage is fine, it's clean and reliable.
ca_declarative: A dependable commodity, not a deliberate choice.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: I choose Heritage because I know where the milk comes from — fresh from the farmer, checked every day, so I know my family is getting real nutrition.
da_declarative: Pure source is the proof of pure nutrition.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_to: consciously chosen source of family nutrition
cb_ca_db_da.caption: The desired attitude layers a rational, verifiable nutrition-through-source proof on top of Heritage's existing freshness trust — it deepens the everyday relationship rather than replacing it.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable everyday milk to consciously chosen source of family nutrition.

draft.smp: Heritage: pure nutrition, because it comes from a pure source.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Owns national trust but at cooperative scale — cannot make an intimate, farmer-to-family source promise the way a directly procuring regional dairy can.
Claims provenance through state pride, but its promise is geographic identity, not a daily, verifiable nutrition-from-source guarantee.
Arokya says 'healthy milk' but leads on the milk's health, not on traceable purity of the source that earns that nutrition.
Talks freshness and farmer sourcing but has not built a systematised, quality-checked-daily proof into the brand promise.
Signals premium 'pure and fresh' but on product quality alone — it lacks the farmer-source-to-nutrition chain of causation.

smp_unlocks.brand_line: Pure source. Pure nutrition. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.mass_line: Achche doodh se hi achchi sehat — asli source se, roz jaanch ke saath. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.activation: 'Meet the source' — QR-on-pack and neighbourhood farmer-fresh days that let women trace their pack back to the procuring farmer and the day's quality check. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.product: A fortified / high-protein 'Heritage Pure Nutrition' range for family and women's daily wellness, carrying the daily-quality-check seal. (illustrative — not final copy)
